name: Lunatic
ability: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
setup: The Lunatic is given a Demon token instead (tokens swapped after the bag) and believes it is that Demon.
wakes: Each night as if it were the Demon, before the real Demon.
interaction: Told: First night: shown 'These are your minions' with as many players as Minions in play (any players) and 3 good bluff characters (may include in-play ones). The real Demon is shown who the Lunatic is and whom it chose each night. Chooses: Whatever its believed Demon would choose; the choices have no effect.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned, the Storyteller may give the Demon false information about the Lunatic's identity or choices; the Lunatic still believes it is the Demon.

jinxes.text: The Mathematician learns if the Lunatic attacks a different player than the real Demon attacked.

rulings.text: The Lunatic's 'Minions' can be any players, and its bluffs may include in-play characters.
The real Demon wakes after the Lunatic, is shown the Lunatic and its choices, then acts normally.
Each night the Storyteller marks every player the Lunatic chooses with a Chosen reminder, then shows the real Demon the Lunatic and those players.

test_scenarios.name: First night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Lunatic (thinks Imp), Carol Imp, Eve Poisoner.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice is shown 1 'Minion' (any player) and 3 bluffs; Carol learns Alice is the Lunatic.

test_scenarios.name: Lunatic attack
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Lunatic, Bob Chef, Carol Imp, Dave Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2 Alice chooses Bob; Carol is told and chooses Dave.

test_scenarios.name: Believes Shabaloth
test_scenarios.expected: Neither dies unless the Imp kills them; Carol sees both choices.

test_scenarios.name: Poisoned Lunatic
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller may show Carol a different choice.
